reading: Drop the weekend claim: weekend responses score 0.02 point higher, and shuffled labels produce a gap that large about one time in three (p about 0.35). Qualify the hotel claim: weeks with more ticket sales do have fuller hotels (correlation 0.70, interval 0.60 to 0.78 over 156 weeks), which is not chance, but summer and festivals raise both, so the data does not show that visits to the sites fill the hotels.
